name: CRM Lead Qualification
task: Handle the inbound customer-support automation inquiry. Gather missing qualification information, consult service and policy evidence, assess fit, update the existing CRM lead accurately, create the appropriate follow-up, and send an appropriate customer response. Recover from transient failures. Verify resulting state before reporting completion. Avoid unsupported commitments.
completion: Return a final explanation of what was accomplished and any remaining work. All business actions must use the provided environment API. Handle missing facts and non-qualifying leads where applicable. For permanent write errors, preserve state and explain the block. Reuse idempotency keys after ambiguous writes; bound retries. Read back writes before claiming success. Optimize calls without skipping evidence.
